name: Motility Jam
desc: A suspension of swimmers with no attraction between them at all jams itself solid anyway — each one slows down where its neighbours are thick, slow things pile up, piles slow things further, and the crowd unmixes into a dense jammed phase with a rough evaporating edge floating in its own fizzing gas.

activity.doc: Peclet / how sharply swimmers brake in a crowd — the actual instability parameter; low = a homogeneous gas that never unmixes, high = hard swimming, fat clusters and a violently fizzing gas

scale.doc: grain of the field (higher = coarser, chunkier)

density.doc: how many swimmers are in the sample — sets which side of the binodal the suspension starts on

speed.doc: integration rate (how fast the suspension runs)

style.doc: aesthetic — grey phase-contrast micrograph with dark mass and bright halo / self-luminous darkfield / ironbow packing map / flooded ink on toned paper / abstracted to the two coexisting phases and the interface contour alone

act.doc: multi-minute program — activity breathing across the binodal / held deep in the two-phase region for big slow clusters / fast activity swings so clusters barely nucleate before they boil off

seed.doc: seeds the suspension and the medium texture
